fields.description_1: Ten Bruggen offers a broad range of financial and advisory services. The website needed to present this expertise without overwhelming visitors. At the same time, the brand had to feel professional, trustworthy and personal, with clear routes towards the right service or direct contact.
fields.description_2: I created a structured WordPress website that puts clarity and conversion first. Services are easier to explore, important information is broken into readable sections and strong calls to action guide visitors towards personal advice. Responsive layouts, direct contact options and online appointment booking make the website practical on every device.

fields.description_1: Sanatolia needed a website that could bring its wide range of cultural activities together in one clear place. Visitors needed to quickly discover courses, upcoming events and practical information, while the organisation’s mission and cultural identity also had to remain visible.
fields.description_2: I structured the website around the most important visitor journeys: discovering events, exploring courses and learning more about Sanatolia. Clear navigation, dedicated content pages and direct routes to tickets, registration and contact make the platform easier to use while giving the organisation enough flexibility to keep its programme up to date.

fields.description_1: Werken bij EFE needed a website that answered practical visitor questions more quickly. The recruitment offer had to be explained with clear context, useful detail, and a visible route to contact. With a tighter structure, the page feels less generic and easier to assess on both desktop and mobile.
fields.description_2: I refined the page by reducing repetition, improving the order of information, and making each section easier to scan. The WordPress build presents the recruitment offer with practical context and steady pacing. Visitors now get clearer reasons to continue, compare the work, and start a conversation.

fields.description_1: RBMB needed a webshop that made its product range easier to understand and navigate. Visitors had to quickly find the right building materials, compare relevant product categories, and feel confident before making an inquiry or purchase.
fields.description_2: I created a more complete WooCommerce webshop experience with clear sections, improved product presentation, and practical conversion points throughout the customer journey. The webshop now explains the offer more clearly, supports visitors with better context, and makes it easier to move from product discovery to contact or purchase. This gives RBMB a stronger online presence and a more reliable path for potential customers.

fields.description_1: Enspect needed project content that is easier to read and more useful for quick comparison. The page had to explain the inspection work without heavy language, while giving visitors enough context to understand the service, trust the presentation and decide whether to get in touch.
fields.description_2: I shaped the page around what visitors need to know first: the offer, the benefit and the next step. Short sections, cleaner wording and focused WordPress delivery make the inspection project easier to judge. The page now feels more specific, useful and ready for inquiries.
